title: Mithu's Grumpy Kingdom
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: A friendly, warm male storyteller voice.

Mithu.look: A fluffy, ginger tabby cat with big, expressive green eyes, wearing a tiny, slightly crooked blue bow tie. He has a perpetually annoyed, grumpy expression, often with narrowed eyes and a slight frown. His fur is sleek and well-groomed.

Priya.look: Young woman, late 20s, light wheatish skin, long soft wavy dark-brown hair tied in a loose, elegant bun. She wears minimal, natural makeup, small gold hoop earrings, and a elegant pastel green kurta with white palazzo pants. Her expression is usually gentle and loving.

Rohit.look: Young man, late 20s, fair skin, short neat black hair, clean-shaven. He wears a casual light blue button-down shirt and dark jeans. His expression is often relaxed, with a good-natured smile.

scenes.image: Extreme close-up of [[Mithu]]'s face, eyes wide in exasperation, mouth open mid-complaint. Dramatic lighting emphasizes his grumpy expression.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Yeh family toh meri life hell bana degi!
scenes.say: ये फैमिली तो मेरी लाइफ हेल बना देगी!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] sitting upright on a plush sofa, looking annoyed towards [[Priya]], who is out of frame. His tiny blue bow tie is slightly crooked.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Meet Mithu, the grumpiest cat in the world.
scenes.say: मीट मिठु, द ग्रंपिएस्ट कैट इन द वर्ल्ड।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] cooing at [[Mithu]], gently stroking his head with a loving smile. [[Mithu]] looks away disdainfully, his ears slightly flattened.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Aww, mera cutie pie! Kitna handsome hai tu!
scenes.say: आव, मेरा क्यूटी पाई! कितना हैंडसम है तू!

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]] rolling his eyes dramatically, looking at the camera as if sharing a secret with the audience.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Cutie pie? Mai ek dignified sher hoon!
scenes.say: क्यूटी पाई? मैं एक डिग्निफाइड शेर हूँ!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] dangling a fluffy feather toy in front of [[Mithu]]. [[Mithu]] bats at it half-heartedly with a bored, unimpressed expression.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Priya, dekho Mithu kitna playful ho raha hai!
scenes.say: प्रिया, देखो मिठु कितना प्लेफुल हो रहा है!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] collapses onto the floor, feigning utter exhaustion, one paw dramatically covering his eyes in protest.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Playful? Bhai, yeh toh torture hai mere liye.
scenes.say: प्लेफुल? भाई, ये तो टॉर्चर है मेरे लिए।

scenes.image: Close-up of a bowl of premium cat food. [[Mithu]]'s nose is wrinkled as he sniffs it disdainfully, turning his head away.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: His complaints ranged from food...
scenes.say: हिज कंप्लेंट्स रेंजेड फ्रॉम फूड...

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] pushing the food bowl away with a paw, his face scrunched up in deep offense, looking at the camera.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Phir se chicken? Kya inke paas aur kuch nahi?
scenes.say: फिर से चिकन? क्या इनके पास और कुछ नहीं?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] trying to nap on a sun-drenched window sill, his eyes squinted tightly against a bright beam of sunlight.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: ...to the morning sun.
scenes.say: ...टू द मॉर्निंग सन।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]] covering his eyes with his paw, a strong beam of sun hitting his annoyed face.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Ugh, yeh suraj seedha meri aankhon mein!
scenes.say: उह, ये सूरज सीधा मेरी आँखों में!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] holding a fluffy white towel, smiling sweetly, while [[Mithu]] peeks out from behind a plush sofa, eyes wide with horror.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Mithu, time for your bath, my sweet!
scenes.say: मिठु, टाइम फॉर योर बाथ, माय स्वीट!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] frantically trying to escape [[Priya]]'s gentle but firm grasp, paws flailing dramatically in mid-air.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Bath? Yeh toh insaani saazish hai!
scenes.say: बाथ? ये तो इंसानी साज़िश है!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] trying to calm a struggling [[Mithu]], who is now dripping wet and looking absolutely furious.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Relax, buddy, it's just water.
scenes.say: रिलैक्स, बडी, इट्स जस्ट वॉटर।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] standing on the bathroom floor, wet and his fur puffed up, glaring accusingly at [[Rohit]] with narrowed eyes.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Just water? Meri fur kharab ho jaayegi!
scenes.say: जस्ट वॉटर? मेरी फर खराब हो जाएगी!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] and [[Rohit]] cuddling [[Mithu]] tightly, both smiling. [[Mithu]] looks stiff and uncomfortable, but doesn't actually try to leave.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: The couple adored Mithu, despite his grumbles.
scenes.say: द कपल अडोर्ड मिठु, डेस्पाइट हिज ग्रंबल्स।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]] looking annoyed by the affection, but a tiny, almost invisible smile plays on his lips, hidden from the owners.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Ah, yeh over-affectionate insaan!
scenes.say: आह, ये ओवर-अफेक्शनट इंसान!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] kissing [[Mithu]] on the head, her eyes full of love. [[Mithu]] twitches his ears in a show of annoyance.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: He's so cute even when he's grumpy.
scenes.say: ही इज सो क्यूट इवन व्हेन ही इज ग्रंपी।

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] laughing softly, gently scratching [[Mithu]] behind the ears. [[Mithu]] leans into the scratch slightly, despite his grumpy face.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Our little King Mithu, always demanding.
scenes.say: आर लिटिल किंग मिठु, ऑलवेज़ डिमांडिंग।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] looking thoughtfully at [[Priya]] and [[Rohit]], a hint of grudging affection visible in his otherwise annoyed eyes.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: King toh mai hoon hi. Par ye log...
scenes.say: किंग तो मैं हूँ ही। पर ये लोग...

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] shrugs his shoulders cartoonishly, looking directly at the camera with a comical expression of judgment.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: ...inka taste thoda off hai, I guess.
scenes.say: ...इनका टेस्ट थोड़ा ऑफ है, आई गेस।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] proudly holding up a small, colourful, jingling cat toy mouse. [[Mithu]] eyes it with extreme suspicion from his perch on the sofa.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: One day, a new 'problem' arrived.
scenes.say: वन डे, अ न्यू 'प्रॉब्लम' अराइव्ड।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] gently placing the jingling toy mouse near [[Mithu]]. [[Mithu]] sniffs it delicately, then recoils in distaste.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Look Mithu, a new friend for you!
scenes.say: लुक मिठु, अ न्यू फ्रेंड फॉर यू!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] batting the toy mouse away dismissively with a paw, his face scrunched up in comical disgust and offense.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Yeh kya plastic ka tukda? Meri insult!
scenes.say: ये क्या प्लास्टिक का टुकड़ा? मेरी इंसल्ट!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] nudging the toy mouse towards [[Mithu]] with his foot, trying to encourage him to play, smiling playfully.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Come on, Mithu, play with it!
scenes.say: कम ऑन, मिठु, प्ले विथ इट!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] sitting upright, looking intellectually superior with a snooty expression, as if reading an invisible book.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: No thanks. Mai toh Aristotle ki essays padhta hoon.
scenes.say: नो थैंक्स। मैं तो एरिस्टोटल की एस्सेज़ पढ़ता हूँ।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] looking a little disappointed, picking up the rejected toy mouse, shrugging her shoulders.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: He's just not feeling it today.
scenes.say: ही इज जस्ट नॉट फीलिंग इट टुडे।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] looking smug, giving a triumphant little flick of his tail, watching [[Priya]] walk away with the toy.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Kabhi feel nahi karunga, Priya ji.
scenes.say: कभी फील नहीं करूँगा, प्रिया जी।

scenes.image: The toy mouse magically appearing on [[Mithu]]'s favourite sleeping spot, right next to his face, as he tries to nap.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: But the toy kept reappearing.
scenes.say: बट द टॉय केप्ट रिअपीयरिंग।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] waking up with a startled gasp, glaring at the toy mouse as if it's a personal enemy and a violation of his space.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Yeh toh stalker nikla! Meri privacy ka kya?
scenes.say: ये तो स्टॉकर निकला! मेरी प्राइवेसी का क्या?

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] shrugging to [[Priya]], both looking at [[Mithu]] from a distance, who is now aggressively ignoring the toy.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Maybe he just needs some space.
scenes.say: मेबी ही जस्ट नीड्स सम स्पेस।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]] making a very serious, determined face, as if planning a grand strategy for rebellion.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mithu decided to take drastic action.
scenes.say: मिठु डिसाइडेड टू टेक ड्रास्टिक एक्शन।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] gathering all his toys, even old ones, and vigorously pushing them into a messy pile on the living room floor.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Ab inko asli gussa dekhna padega!
scenes.say: अब इनको असली गुस्सा देखना पड़ेगा!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] looking horrified, hands clasped, as [[Mithu]] makes a mess, pushing cushions off the sofa onto his toy pile.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Mithu, what are you doing? My decor!
scenes.say: मिठु, व्हाट आर यू डूइंग? माय डेकोर!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] standing triumphantly atop the pile of cushions and toys, looking defiant with a paw raised.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Yeh toh mera protest hai, na samajh insaan!
scenes.say: ये तो मेरा प्रोटेस्ट है, ना समझ इंसान!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] trying to hold back a chuckle, covering his mouth slightly, watching [[Mithu]]'s dramatic antics.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: He's having a tantrum, is he?
scenes.say: ही इज हैविंग अ टेंट्रम, इज ही?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] strikes a comical revolutionary pose, one paw raised high in the air, looking utterly serious.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Tantrum? Mai toh revolution laa raha hoon!
scenes.say: टेंट्रम? मैं तो रेवोल्यूशन ला रहा हूँ!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] holding up a tiny, colourful knitted sweater for a cat, smiling brightly, while [[Mithu]] peeks from behind a plant with terror in his eyes.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: But Priya had a different idea.
scenes.say: बट प्रिया हैड अ डिफरेंट आइडिया।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] approaching [[Mithu]] with the dreaded sweater, her face full of excited anticipation.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: It's a sweater! For my little baby!
scenes.say: इट्स अ स्वेटर! फॉर माय लिटिल बेबी!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] running away frantically, looking over his shoulder at the colourful knitted sweater with a look of pure dread.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Sweater? Mai toh fashion icon hoon!
scenes.say: स्वेटर? मैं तो फैशन आइकन हूँ!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] hiding completely under the bed, only his wide, fearful eyes peeking out, refusing to come out.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Yeh toh meri image kharab kar dega!
scenes.say: ये तो मेरी इमेज खराब कर देगा!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] trying to coax [[Mithu]] out from under the bed with a treat, kneeling down. [[Mithu]] glares, refusing the offering.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Come on, Mithu, it's cute!
scenes.say: कम ऑन, मिठु, इट्स क्यूट!

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]] shaking his head vehemently from under the bed, his mouth forming a firm 'no' (cartoonishly).
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: No amount of treat will make me wear that!
scenes.say: नो अमाउंट ऑफ ट्रीट विल मेक मी वियर दैट!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] following [[Priya]] around the living room, constantly meowing (implied talking), one paw on his hip (cartoonishly).
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mithu's complaints escalated to a new level.
scenes.say: मिठुज कंप्लेंट्स एस्केलेटेड टू अ न्यू लेवल।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] pointing a paw at a dripping kitchen tap, looking severely disappointed and judgmental at [[Priya]].
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Pani ka tap खुला reh gaya! Kitni wasteful ho!
scenes.say: पानी का टैप खुला रह गया! कितनी वेस्टफुल हो!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] quickly turning off the tap, looking a bit flustered and apologetic to [[Mithu]].
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Oh, I'm so sorry, Mithu!
scenes.say: ओह, आई एम सो सॉरी, मिठु!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] standing by a light switch, looking up at a lit bulb in an empty room, shaking his head in disapproval.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Lights on? Jab koi room mein nahi hai?
scenes.say: लाइट्स ऑन? जब कोई रूम में नहीं है?

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] rushing to switch off the light, looking sheepish and embarrassed by [[Mithu]]'s observation.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Oops, my bad, buddy.
scenes.say: ऊप्स, माय बैड, बडी।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] sitting on the kitchen counter, overseeing [[Priya]] cooking, with a scrutinizing and critical look on his face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mithu was now a full-time critic.
scenes.say: मिठु वॉज़ नाउ अ फुल-टाइम क्रिटिक।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] making a precise gesture with his paw, as if balancing spices, looking like a master chef advising [[Priya]].
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Namak kam hai, Priya. Aur haldi thodi zyada.
scenes.say: नमक कम है, प्रिया। और हल्दी थोड़ी ज्यादा।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] looking surprised but nodding attentively, adjusting the spices in her cooking, while [[Rohit]] watches, amused.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Oh, really? Okay, I'll fix it!
scenes.say: ओह, रियली? ओके, आई विल फिक्स इट!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] sitting quietly on the sofa, looking out the window, unusually pensive and still, with a subtle golden light.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: One evening, something changed.
scenes.say: वन इवनिंग, समथिंग चेंज्ड।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] looking around the quiet living room, a subtle sense of unease creeping onto his face, confused by the silence.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Aaj kitni shanti hai. Yeh log chup kyun hain?
scenes.say: आज कितनी शांति है। ये लोग चुप क्यूँ हैं?

scenes.image: [[Priya]] whispering to [[Rohit]], both watching [[Mithu]] from a distance, looking genuinely worried about his unusual silence.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Rohit, Mithu isn't complaining today.
scenes.say: प्रिया, मिठु इजन्ट कंप्लेनिंग टुडे।

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] gently approaching [[Mithu]], who doesn't react or complain, looking deep in thought. Rohit's face shows concern.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: He seems... quiet. Is he okay?
scenes.say: ही सीम्स... क्वाइट। इज ही ओके?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]] looking confused, scratching his ear with a paw, genuinely wondering what's wrong with his humans.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Koi galti toh nahi kar di maine?
scenes.say: कोई गलती तो नहीं कर दी मैंने?

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] trying to playfully bat at [[Rohit]]'s shoelace, but [[Rohit]] is engrossed in his phone, not noticing [[Mithu]].
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: No complaints meant no attention.
scenes.say: नो कंप्लेंट्स मेंट नो अटेंशन।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] looking directly at [[Rohit]]'s phone, then back at [[Rohit]]'s face with a frustrated, ignored expression.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Arre, ignore mat karo! Mujhe daanto!
scenes.say: अरे, इग्नोर मत करो! मुझे डाँटो!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] saying this hopefully, but also looking a bit sad that her grumpy cat isn't grumpy anymore.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Maybe he's finally matured.
scenes.say: मेबी ही इज़ फाइनली मैच्योर्ड।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] throwing his paws up in exasperation, his face showing clear boredom and feeling utterly ignored.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Mature? Mai toh bored ho raha hoon!
scenes.say: मैच्योर? मैं तो बोर हो रहा हूँ!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] observing [[Mithu]] with a sympathetic expression. [[Mithu]] genuinely looks deflated and sad.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: He looks... sad.
scenes.say: ही लुक्स... सैड।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] and [[Rohit]] looking at each other across the room, a secret, knowing smile passing between them.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Priya and Rohit exchanged a knowing glance.
scenes.say: प्रिया एंड रोहित एक्सेंज्ड अ नोइंग ग्लांस।

scenes.image: [[Priya]] walks up to [[Mithu]], kneels down, and looks him directly in the eyes with a warm, mischievous smile.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Okay, that's enough.
scenes.say: ओके, दैट्स इनफ।

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] joins [[Priya]], both looking at [[Mithu]] with mischievous grins, as if about to share a secret.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Time for the big reveal, buddy.
scenes.say: टाइम फॉर द बिग रिवील, बडी।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] looks between [[Priya]] and [[Rohit]], a sudden spark of curiosity and confusion in his wide eyes.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Reveal? Kya chal raha hai?
scenes.say: रिवील? क्या चल रहा है?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Mithu]]'s face, his eyes wide, jaw drops cartoonishly, a look of utter shock and disbelief frozen on his features.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Mithu, we know you talk.
scenes.say: मिठु, वी नो यू टॉक।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]] frantically pointing at himself with one paw, then at [[Priya]] and [[Rohit]] with the other, in utter disbelief.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Kya?! Kaise?! Impossible!
scenes.say: क्या?! कैसे?! इम्पॉसिबल!

scenes.image: [[Rohit]] winks at [[Mithu]], smiling warmly, confirming the secret understanding.
scenes.speaker: Rohit
scenes.line: Aur humein tumhari complaints bahut pasand hain!
scenes.say: और हमें तुम्हारी कंप्लेंट्स बहुत पसंद हैं!

scenes.image: [[Mithu]]'s expression shifts from shock to a comical mixture of embarrassment and indignant betrayal, a slight blush on his cheeks.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Matlab, you guys were pretending?
scenes.say: मतलब, यू गाइज़ वर प्रिटेंडिंग?

scenes.image: [[Priya]] picking up a flustered [[Mithu]] and hugging him tightly. [[Mithu]] looks surprised but a tiny, secret smile forms on his face, secretly pleased.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Your grumbles are our daily entertainment, silly.
scenes.say: योर ग्रंबल्स आर आर डेली एंटरटेनमेंट, सिली।

scenes.image: [[Mithu]], now comfortably in [[Priya]]'s arms, looks directly at the camera with a half-annoyed, half-loving smirk. He still has his bow tie.
scenes.speaker: Mithu
scenes.line: Ugh, insaan! Kya aapka pet bhi complain karta hai?
scenes.say: उह, इंसान! क्या आपका पेट भी कंप्लेन करता है?

caption: This Grumpy Cat Complained ALL Day... Then His Owners Revealed Their Secret 😼
yt_title: This Grumpy Cat Complained ALL Day... Then His Owners Revealed Their Secret 😼
description: Meet Mithu, the world's grumpiest talking cat whose daily life is a string of complaints. But what if his sweet owners aren't as clueless as he thinks? A hilarious twist will leave you purring! Kya aapka pet bhi Mithu ki tarah complain karta hai? Tell us in the comments!
comment_question: Kya aapka pet bhi Mithu ki tarah complain karta hai?
